variants.title: A 温润浅色
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate a polished, high-fidelity visual design mockup for Dovun, an independent personal-workspace desktop app. This must look like a beautifully art-directed, plausible shipped software interface with refined materials, not a wireframe, generic admin template, website or marketing landing page.
Reference image 1 is ONLY the existing Dovun logo asset: use its three staggered navy/coral pieces, stepped returning spine and two open gaps at a small size next to the wordmark "dovun". Do NOT make a poster of the logo. Invent the application UI from scratch.
Composition: landscape 16:10, one large front-facing desktop application window, near edge-to-edge with just a narrow surrounding neutral margin. Crisp orthographic screen, no tilted perspective, laptop, phone, hands, desk props, illustrations or collage. App occupies 96% of canvas, readable UI details. Rich visual craft should come from typography, proportions, surfaces, calibrated fine shadows and spacing. Keep practical information density. Not oversized empty whitespace.
Product: personal work comes first. Screen is "今天" (Today), not a new dashboard/home. Tasks, planning, source material and accumulated work belong to the user; optional AI assists in a supporting right pane. No KPI tiles, analytics charts, fake gauges or generic bento boxes. Show only existing app capabilities.
Real layout: compact navigation sidebar with Dovun brand, search, grouped everyday items, user lists, library/context and AI collaboration; main work area has date, Today heading, one compact task capture field and 5-6 clear task rows in sections; a slim agenda/context region and/or AI companion can be integrated as described in the direction. Show calm round task check circles, small category labels, unobtrusive due times, a single selected task state. Hierarchy should be immediately legible.
Chinese UI, carefully rendered clean sans-serif type, slightly larger readable titles, precise optical alignment. Required labels, render verbatim where shown: "dovun", "个人工作台", "今天", "规划", "专注", "统计", "清单", "收集箱", "Dovun 品牌改造", "产品调研", "积累", "资料库", "工作上下文", "AI 协作", "待确认", "AI 助手". Main date "10月23日，星期五". Main title "今天". Task section labels "进行中", "今天稍后". Example task titles "整理个人工作台的视觉方案", "核对小尺寸图标", "补充产品调研资料", "整理本周工作记录", "阅读产品设计笔记". Times "09:30", "11:00", "15:00". Assistant heading "Dovun 工作助手", concise greeting "一起把工作往前推。", prompt suggestion "帮我梳理今天的安排". Keep text concise instead of tiny illegible paragraphs.
Brand palette is deep ink navy #354d85 and warm coral #cf7659, alongside sophisticated neutrals. Priority/status colors stay distinct. No neon, purple AI glow, rainbow gradients, huge glass bubbles, ornamental 3D icons or generic feature cards. Render as an exceptional actual software screen with believable controls and restraint. No captions outside the interface, no direction title, watermark or explanatory annotations.
DIRECTION A — PORCELAIN NATIVE WORKSPACE. Very high-end light theme, warm ivory canvas, softly luminous porcelain-white main workspace, pale stone sidebar, subtle navy active navigation inset, tiny terracotta highlights. A slim border and extremely gentle ambient shadow create a layered inset workspace, with a smaller softly elevated task detail/notes surface and a beautifully proportioned right-hand AI companion pane. The main Today task surface is an elegant continuous sheet with finely spaced rows, not individual card boxes. Rounded outer window corners approximately 18px, internal surfaces 10-12px; tactile precision and thin warm-gray hairlines. Crisp graphite Chinese typography, refined small uppercase-free metadata, ample but purposeful whitespace. The feeling is calm, premium, warm, beautifully composed native desktop software. Subtle surface softness and fine light edges, not flat spreadsheet grey. Include the user's current task selected and a compact lower-right suggestion panel with a restrained navy action. This direction should feel immediately pleasant to use for hours.

DIRECTION C — EDITORIAL TWO-TONE WORKBENCH. Distinctive composition: solid deep muted navy left rail with crisp pale navigation text, a clean warm-white inset main workspace and a slim paper-toned context column. A confident typographic Today header anchors the page; date and compact actions align on a single tidy baseline. Main content splits into a broad task-list column and a narrower practical daily timeline column, using a shared baseline grid and a single quiet vertical divider. Use a thin terracotta line and small terracotta tabs to tie current work to the logo. Feels like an exceptionally designed personal studio notebook translated into capable desktop software.
